observations: Photo 0 shows two units side by side: a white open shelving unit on the left and a white cabinet with glass front on the right.
The open shelving unit has multiple compartments of varying sizes, some with small drawers or sliding panels.
The glass-front cabinet has three shelves, a dark interior, and a metal frame at the top; it appears to be a display cabinet.
Photo 1 shows the open shelving unit from a different angle, confirming its structure and white finish.
Photo 2 shows the glass-front cabinet from the front, with jars placed on the top shelf for display.
Both units appear to be made of particle board or MDF with a white paint finish.
The glass-front cabinet has a visible lock mechanism on the left side.
No brand or model markings are visible on either unit in any photo.
The seller's text suggests use in a pharmacy or provision shop, implying commercial utility.

response.reason: The item is identifiable as a two-piece shelving unit suitable for commercial or personal use. While some risks exist (damage, lock functionality, finish condition), they are common in second-hand furniture and can be priced at worst case. The seller's claims are mostly supported by the photos. No fraud indicators are present.
